implementationDetails.audioStrategy: One AudioContext, one destination connection. Grand, Upright and Electric play bundled recordings (71 mono 16-bit PCM WAV files, 24 kHz, 9.26 MB, under public/samples/); Clav, Digital and Misc are live oscillator synthesis, as is the labelled fallback voice used when a recorded set cannot be loaded. Each note builds a voice per enabled piano layer: sample player or oscillator stack -> per-voice lowpass tone filter -> velocity gain -> stereo panner (unison spread) -> the layer's voice bus. Each layer runs voice bus -> timbre stage (two biquads) -> Mod 1 -> Mod 2 -> Delay -> Amp Sim/EQ or 24 dB filter -> Compressor -> Reverb -> layer level, then into the piano bus, or into the shared Rotary when To Rotary is selected. Both paths meet at the master gain, which feeds a wave-shaper limiter and then the single destination. Nothing bypasses the master path.
